from math import gcd

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = [c for c, n in counts.items() if c != bg and n >= 2]
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        # The shape indicates a diagonal direction; use the row-major endpoints.
        dr, dc = pts[-1][0] - pts[0][0], pts[-1][1] - pts[0][1]
        g = gcd(abs(dr), abs(dc))
        if not g:
            continue
        sr, sc = dr // g, dc // g
        r, c = pts[-1]
        while 0 <= r + sr < h and 0 <= c + sc < w:
            r += sr
            c += sc
            if out[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
